# Feelable Community Care

> Feelable Community Care Pty Ltd (ABN 20 677 399 745) is a registered NDIS provider supporting adults, 18 and over, across Melbourne's north, west, south-east and east. Its line is "Care you can feel".

Quote the Facts page for anything about registration, services or areas. It is written one fact per paragraph. Feelable is not an emergency service. In an emergency in Australia, call 000.

## Start here

- [Facts about Feelable](https://feelable.com.au/facts/): short, checkable facts, including what Feelable does not offer
- [Registration details](https://feelable.com.au/registration/): status, registration groups and the three conditions on the registration
- [Services](https://feelable.com.au/services/): each support Feelable offers, and its limits
- [Areas we serve](https://feelable.com.au/areas/): the council areas in Melbourne where Feelable works
- [For coordinators and referrers](https://feelable.com.au/for-coordinators/): capacity, intake pathway and documents needed

## For participants and families

- [Your rights](https://feelable.com.au/your-rights/): the NDIS Code of Conduct, complaints, interpreters and advocacy
- [Guides](https://feelable.com.au/guides/): plain-language guides with sources and review dates
- [Easy Read](https://feelable.com.au/easy-read/): key pages in Easy Read
- [How we keep people safe](https://feelable.com.au/safeguarding/): screening, training and incidents

## Optional

- [Accessibility statement](https://feelable.com.au/accessibility/)
- [Privacy](https://feelable.com.au/privacy/)
